**High/correctness (committed-artifact acceptance unmet):** Committed the complete F003 documentation set in `ba0410f` — `docs/AGENT_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md` (now tracked, was untracked), `README.md`, `docs/ECOSYSTEM.md` (OpenCode caller row), and `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/agent_brief.py` (CAPABILITY MATRIX pointer, GENERATOR_VERSION 1.1→1.2). All five paths now show no diff against HEAD. Note: no prior commits existed for this plan, so the README's already-staged F001/F002 taxonomy hunks necessarily rode along in the whole-file commit; this is stated in the commit message. The staged-but-uncommitted F002 files (`doc_drift.py`, `test_doc_drift_guard_f002.py`) were left untouched for their own feature's close-out.

**Low/test_coverage (no regression assertion for the brief's matrix pointer):** Added `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_agent_brief_capability_matrix_f003.py` (included in the same commit) with three tests: the rendered brief contains the CAPABILITY MATRIX section with `CAPABILITY_MATRIX_POINTER` verbatim; the pointer names `docs/AGENT_CAPABILITY_MATRIX.md`, all three axes (`can_operate`/`can_be_dispatched`/`can_orchestrate`), and `dontpanic agent status`; and the pointed-to doc exists in the repo with the axes as table columns plus the `opencode` operator-surface row. Targeted verification: new file plus adjacent `test_f001_agent_brief.py` and `test_doc_drift_
